Black running boards and the integrated box side step provide functional style and easier bed access. The spray-in Tough Bed bedliner protects your truck bed from daily wear and provides reliable surface grip for cargo.

Safety features include electronic stability control, speed-sensing steering, dual front and side impact airbags, and front and rear parking sensors. Auto high-beam headlights, front fog lights, and rain-sensing wipers enhance visibility in various conditions, while the SYNC 4 911 Assist emergency communication system provides added peace of mind.

The 2025 Ford Maverick Lobo High represents a thoughtfully engineered compact truck designed for buyers who value capability, modern technology, and refined comfort in a practical package.

- 19" Black Painted Aluminum Wheels
- B&O Sound System by Bang & Olufsen with SiriusXM 360L
- SYNC 4 with Enhanced Voice Recognition and Connected Navigation
- Ford Co-Pilot Assist 2.0 with Pro Trailer Backup Assist and Pro Trailer Hitch Assist
- Tough Bed Spray-In Bedliner with Bed Tie Down Locking Rails
- Dual-Zone Electronic Automatic Temperature Control with Heated Seats
- Power Moonroof with Power-Sliding Rear Window
- Wireless Charging Pad and 400W Inverter
- Heated Steering Wheel with Ambient Lighting
- 360-Degree Camera with Front and Rear Parking Sensors
- Electric Sound Enhancement and Acoustic Windshield
- Front and Rear All-Weather Floor Liners
- Blind Spot Assist, Lane-Keeping System, and Evasive Steering Assist

This Blue EcoBoost-powered truck delivers capable performance with its 2.0L turbocharged engine and seven-speed automatic transmission paired with all-wheel drive. The combination returns an estimated 21 city and 30 highway miles per gallon, offering a practical balance between efficiency and the power you expect from a modern truck. The spacious bed accommodates your gear with professional-grade protection, while the spray-in bedliner ensures durability against the elements and daily use.

Inside, you'll find a thoughtfully designed cabin where technology seamlessly integrates with comfort. The SYNC 4 system with voice recognition keeps you connected, while the premium B&O sound system transforms your daily commute into an enjoyable experience. Heated seats and steering wheel provide comfort during colder months, and the wireless charging pad keeps your devices ready. The dual-zone climate control ensures both driver and passenger comfort, while ambient lighting creates an inviting atmosphere.

Safety and convenience features work together to support your journey. Ford Co-Pilot Assist 2.0 helps guide you on the road, while Pro Trailer Backup Assist and Pro Trailer Hitch Assist simplify towing tasks. The 360-degree camera system with front and rear sensors provides visibility around the truck, giving you confidence in tight spaces or challenging situations.

Your investment in this vehicle includes Ford Gold Certification with comprehensive peace of mind:

- 172 Point Inspection
- Roadside Assistance
- Warranty Deductible: $100
- Transferable Warranty
- Vehicle History
- Limited Warranty: 12 Month/12,000 Mile (whichever comes first) after new car warranty expires or from certified purchase date

description:
Meet the 2025 Ram 1500 Big Horn/Lone Star, a truck built to handle your toughest demands while delivering the comfort and technology you deserve in a workhorse that refuses to compromise.

- 3.0L I-6 Twin Turbocharged Engine with 4WD capability
- 9 Amplified Speakers with Subwoofer audio system
- 12" Touchscreen Display with GPS Navigation
- Apple CarPlay and Google Android Auto
- Uconnect 5 Navigation System with SiriusXM 360L
- Heated Front Seats and Heated Steering Wheel
- Power Adjustable Pedals and Power 8-Way Driver Seat
- Leather Wrapped Steering Wheel
- Configurable Drive Mode for versatile performance
- Auto Power-Folding Mirrors with Supplemental Signals
- Rear Power Sliding Window and Remote Tailgate Release
- 400W Inverter and dual 115V Auxiliary Power Outlets
- Dual-Zone Automatic Temperature Control
- ParkView Rear Back-Up Camera
- 18" Cast-Aluminum Painted Wheels

This Ram combines genuine capability with thoughtful features designed for everyday comfort. The 3.0L turbocharged engine delivers substantial power paired with the efficiency of 8-speed automatic transmission, while the four-wheel-drive system gives you confidence on any terrain or weather condition. The truck's interior reflects Big Horn/Lone Star standards with bucket seating, full-length floor console, and a rear center armrest that make cab time more enjoyable.

Technology integrates seamlessly into your driving experience. The 12-inch touchscreen anchors the Uconnect 5 navigation system, offering GPS functionality alongside SiriusXM 360L satellite radio. Smartphone integration through Apple CarPlay and Google Android Auto keeps you connected without distraction, while the nine-channel amplified audio system with subwoofer ensures every drive sounds premium.

Convenience features simplify ownership. Heated front seats and a heated steering wheel adapt to cold weather driving, while power-adjustable pedals accommodate drivers of different heights. The rear power sliding window enhances versatility, and dual 115V outlets—plus a 400W inverter—provide practical power for tools and equipment. Remote tailgate release and the integrated garage door opener add daily functionality that matters.

Safety technology works quietly in the background. The ParkView backup camera assists with reversing, while electronic stability control and traction control manage grip in challenging conditions. Eight airbags, including dual front and side-impact protection, prioritize occupant security across all seating positions.

This truck arrives ready for work and weekend adventures alike, equipped with premium finishes and genuine utility. Visit us to experience how this Ram 1500 Big Horn/Lone Star balances strength with the refinement you expect.

This 2025 Ford F-150 XLT in black delivers the capability and comfort you need from a modern pickup truck.

- Leather interior
- Low mileage
- 2.7L V6 EcoBoost engine with 10-speed automatic transmission
- 4WD capability
- Equipment Group 301A with chrome accents and black grille
- Dual-zone electronic automatic temperature control
- 6" angular bright anodized step bar
- Chrome door and tailgate handles
- SiriusXM 360L satellite radio with 6 speakers
- SYNC 4 with enhanced voice recognition and navigation
- Heated seats
- Back-up camera with rear parking sensors

- Towing package
- 18" chrome-like PVD wheels

The 2.7L V6 EcoBoost engine provides efficient power while maintaining excellent fuel economy at 18 city and 24 highway MPG. The 10-speed automatic transmission works seamlessly to optimize performance and efficiency across all driving conditions. You'll appreciate the responsive handling that comes with the independent front suspension and four-wheel disc brakes with ABS.

The dual-zone electronic automatic temperature control lets both driver and passenger manage comfort independently. Connectivity is straightforward with SYNC 4 featuring enhanced voice recognition, giving you intuitive control over navigation, music, and vehicle functions through SiriusXM 360L satellite radio.

Safety features include dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, overhead airbags, electronic stability control, and traction control. The back-up camera combined with rear parking sensors and blind spot monitoring provides confidence when maneuvering. FordPass Connect 5G enables remote access to your vehicle through the smartphone app.

Practical features for truck life include the towing package, 6" step bar for easier entry, and remote keyless entry for convenience. The telescoping tilt steering wheel adjusts to your preference, while heated seats and mirrors add comfort during cold weather driving.

This 2025 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 LT LT1 combines capability and refinement with a design built to handle whatever comes your way. With low mileage and factory warranty remaining, this truck offers the reliability you expect from a Chevrolet pickup backed by comprehensive peace of mind.

- EcoTec3 5.3L V8 engine with Dynamic Fuel Management for optimized power and efficiency
- 4WD for confident traction in diverse driving conditions
- 10-Speed Automatic transmission with integrated trailer brake controller
- Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium system with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- SiriusXM with 360L satellite radio trial subscription
- Dual-Zone Automatic Climate Control with heated front seats and heated steering wheel
- Trailering Package including hitch guidance and external transmission oil cooler
- EZ Lift Power Lock & Release tailgate
- Remote Vehicle Starter System for convenience in any season
- 12.3" reconfigurable digital driver display for enhanced visibility
- Automatic Emergency Braking and Lane Keep Assist with Lane Departure Warning

- Alloy wheels with all-terrain capability

The heart of this Silverado is its 5.3L EcoTec3 V8, engineered with Dynamic Fuel Management technology that shifts between 17 different operating patterns to balance power delivery with fuel efficiency. This intelligent engine management ensures you get strong performance when you need it and better fuel economy during highway driving. The 10-speed automatic transmission works seamlessly with the engine to deliver responsive acceleration and smooth gear transitions.

Built for truck owners who value both capability and daily comfort, this Silverado LT LT1 equips you with practical features that matter. The Trailering Package provides integrated towing control, while the remote starter gets your cab ready before you step outside. Power-adjustable heated mirrors, automatic high-beam headlights with IntelliBeam technology, and a heated steering wheel make cold mornings manageable. The cabin features cloth seating with a heated driver seat, 40/20/40 split-bench front seating, and a spacious rear bench that folds for cargo flexibility.

Technology integration keeps you connected without distraction. The Chevrolet Infotainment 3 Premium system seamlessly pairs with your smartphone through Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, ensuring navigation, music, and calls remain accessible. Steering wheel audio controls and 6-speaker surround sound with SiriusXM create an engaging driving environment. The 12.3" digital display puts essential information directly in your line of sight.

Safety features work together to keep you and your passengers protected. Automatic Emergency Braking, Forward Collision Alert, and Front Pedestrian Braking provide multiple layers of crash avoidance. Lane Keep Assist gently guides you back if you drift, while the HD rear camera clarifies what's behind you during reversals. OnStar emergency services are capable and ready if needed.

This truck is ready to work and ready to drive home. With factory warranty remaining and low mileage for a 2025 model, you're getting a Silverado that has just begun its service life. The combination of proven engineering, thoughtful amenities, and genuine truck capability makes this LT LT1 a solid choice for buyers seeking a full-size pickup that delivers on both work and everyday driving expectations.

Inside, the interior balances comfort with practicality. SYNC 4 with Enhanced Voice Recognition allows easy interaction with your phone and infotainment features without taking your hands off the wheel. SiriusXM 360L satellite radio keeps you connected to your favorite content. Front bucket seats with sport cloth upholstery and a full center armrest provide support for long drives, while the split folding rear seat accommodates passengers or expands cargo flexibility.

Rear parking sensors help with precision backing, while emergency communication through SYNC 4 911 Assist provides an additional layer of security.

We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience this 2025 Ford F-150 STX firsthand. Our team is ready to answer your questions and help you find the right truck for your needs.

This 2025 Ford Ranger XL represents a straightforward, well-equipped truck ready to support your lifestyle. With its proven EcoBoost engine, modern connectivity, and practical truck features, it's ready to be part of your next chapter. We invite you to come in and experience this Ranger firsthand.

Meet the 2025 Chevrolet Colorado Trail Boss, a truck built to handle your toughest demands while delivering the comfort and capability you need for both work and adventure.

Leather seating surfaces add refinement, and the power-adjustable driver seat with lumbar support ensures you stay comfortable on long drives. The 11.3-inch touchscreen display keeps you connected with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, while wireless phone charging and remote start technology add convenient features for daily use.

Safety remains a priority with Chevy Safety Assist, forward collision alert, lane keep assist, and automatic emergency braking working together to help protect you and your passengers. The backup camera provides visibility when backing up, and the OnStar emergency communication system offers peace of mind.

With an 18-gallon fuel tank and real-world performance figures of 18 city and 23 highway miles per gallon, this Colorado balances power with efficiency. The LT275/65R18 Goodyear Wrangler Territory tires are ready for various road conditions, while the black spray-on bedliner protects your truck bed from the rigors of work and adventure.

This white Trail Boss is ready to become your trusted partner for years to come. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience the Colorado firsthand and see why this truck stands as a dependable choice for those who demand both capability and quality.

This 2025 Ford F-150 XLT 301A is built to handle whatever demands you place on it, combining capable performance with the refinements that make daily driving comfortable and convenient.

The white exterior gives this truck a clean, professional appearance that works equally well on the job site or in everyday use.

Inside, the cabin reflects Ford's commitment to driver comfort and connectivity. SYNC 4 with enhanced voice recognition keeps you connected safely, while the dual-zone climate control ensures both driver and passenger comfort on long drives. The wrapped steering wheel and telescoping tilt adjustment let you find your ideal driving position, and the cloth 40/20/40 front seat with console provides practical storage for your essentials.

Safety features are comprehensive, including dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, and an overhead airbag system. Electronic stability control, traction control, and brake assist work together to help you maintain control. The rear parking sensors add convenience when maneuvering in tight spaces, and the security system gives you peace of mind.

The styling enhancements of the 301A package are visible throughout—from the black painted grille with chrome center bar to the chrome door and tailgate handles and chrome single-tip exhaust. The 6" angular bright anodized step bar makes entry easier while adding a polished look. These details demonstrate that capability doesn't mean sacrificing appearance.

At 33,315 miles, this F-150 XLT still has plenty of service ahead while offering the reliability Ford trucks are known for. The combination of proven capability, thoughtful features, and crisp white finish makes this a truck ready to work or drive with confidence.

Meet the 2025 Jeep Gladiator Sport S, a capable midsize truck built for those who value both work and adventure. This green machine combines the heritage of the Jeep brand with modern utility, delivering a vehicle that performs on-site and off-road alike.

- Android Auto and Apple CarPlay connectivity
- Uconnect 5 with 12.3" touchscreen display
- Enhanced Adaptive Cruise Control
- Full Speed Forward Collision Warning Plus
- Heated front seats and heated steering wheel
- Remote Start System
- 4G LTE Wi-Fi Hot Spot with Alexa Built-In
- Class IV Receiver Hitch with Trailer Hitch Zoom
- Heavy-Duty Engine Cooling and MOPAR Spray-In Bedliner
- Body Color 3-Piece Hard Top with Freedom Panel Storage
- Dark Sky Appearance Package with Performance Hood and gloss black accents
- Power heated mirrors and automatic headlamps
- ParkView Rear Back-Up Camera
- Tri-Fold Bed Cover

The 3.6L V6 engine with 8-speed automatic transmission and 4WD delivers solid performance, achieving 17 mpg city and 22 mpg highway. You'll find this truck responsive and stable whether you're navigating city streets or tackling rougher terrain. The suspension is engineered to handle the demands of truck ownership while maintaining a reasonable ride quality for daily driving.

Inside, the cabin reflects a practical design focused on durability and comfort. The heated front seats and heated steering wheel add genuine value for year-round driving, while the premium wrapped steering wheel enhances your grip and control. Climate control operates automatically to maintain your preferred temperature, and the power windows, remote keyless entry, and universal garage door opener streamline everyday conveniences.

Technology features integration is straightforward and intuitive. The Uconnect 5 system with its 12.3-inch display connects seamlessly with your smartphone through Apple CarPlay or Android Auto. The 4G LTE Wi-Fi hotspot keeps passengers connected, and Alexa Built-In offers voice-activated control for compatible smart home devices. SiriusXM satellite radio rounds out your entertainment options.

Safety and capability go hand-in-hand on this Gladiator. Advanced Brake Assist, Electronic Stability Control, and traction control work together to provide confidence in varied driving conditions. The ParkView Rear Back-Up Camera shows what's behind you when reversing, and multiple airbags protect occupants in an impact. For towing tasks, the Class IV Receiver Hitch and heavy-duty engine cooling prepare the truck to handle trailers and loads effectively.

This vehicle comes to you as a local trade-in from a non-smoker, with a fresh oil change and full detail completed. The alloy wheels, tri-fold bed cover, and MOPAR spray-in bedliner provide practical protection and style. We invite you to visit our showroom to inspect this Gladiator in person and explore how it can serve your lifestyle.

The HD rear vision camera and hitch guidance system make backing up and towing straightforward, while OnStar services provide added peace of mind. Multiple airbags and a solid frame structure provide comprehensive protection.

Built for utility, this Silverado includes practical features that matter. The integrated trailer brake controller and front recovery hooks support trailering capability, while the bed-mounted 120-volt outlet powers tools and equipment. The Chevytec spray-on bedliner protects against wear, and the all-weather floor liners help maintain the cabin's condition.

Discover the 2025 Hyundai Santa Cruz Limited, a versatile vehicle that combines practical capability with refined comfort in an innovative design that stands apart on today's roads.

- Heated and ventilated front seats for year-round comfort
- Apple CarPlay and Android Auto connectivity
- Power moonroof for open-air enjoyment
- Navigation system for confident travel
- Steering wheel-mounted audio controls
- Heated steering wheel
- Exterior parking camera rear
- Bose premium audio system with eight speakers and SiriusXM
- Leather-trimmed seat trim with memory settings
- Automatic temperature control with front dual zone
- Power driver and passenger seats
- Auto high-beam headlights
- Alloy wheels (20" x 7.5J)
- Illuminated entry

This Santa Cruz arrives finished in eye-catching green with a 2.5L four-cylinder engine paired with Shiftronic transmission and all-wheel drive, delivering an effective balance of capability and efficiency. With city fuel economy of 19 MPG and highway performance of 27 MPG, this vehicle accommodates both daily commuting and longer journeys without demanding constant refueling.

Step inside to find a thoughtfully appointed cabin where leather-trimmed seating and dual-zone automatic temperature control establish an environment of comfort and control. The heated steering wheel, heated and ventilated front seats, and memory driver's seat adjust to your preferences, while the power moonroof above brings natural light and fresh air to the driving experience. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls and a Bose premium audio system paired with SiriusXM ensure your entertainment remains accessible and immersive throughout every drive.

Advanced convenience features demonstrate Hyundai's commitment to modern driving. Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration keeps your smartphone seamlessly connected, while the navigation system guides you to any destination with precision. Illuminated entry lighting welcomes you, and the remote keyless entry system provides hassle-free access to your vehicle at any hour.

Safety technology encompasses multiple layers of protection, including dual front impact airbags, front and rear side impact airbags, and overhead airbags. Electronic stability control, traction control, brake assist, and a security system work together to maintain your confidence on the road. The four-wheel independent suspension and speed-sensing steering contribute to responsive handling, while an exterior parking camera rear simplifies maneuvering in tight spaces.

Practical features support everyday use: carpeted floor mats protect the interior, a bed mat preserves the cargo area, and a first aid kit provides readiness for unexpected situations. The split-folding rear seat adapts to your cargo needs, expanding versatility for hauling equipment or passengers as your situation requires.

An extended warranty is available for purchase, offering additional protection and peace of mind beyond the factory coverage.

Introducing the 2025 Ford F-150 XLT in striking white, a capable truck built for those who demand both performance and practicality in their daily work and adventures.

- Electronic Locking w/3.55 Axle Ratio
- Dual-Zone Electronic Automatic Temperature Control
- Wrapped Steering Wheel
- Auto High-beam Headlights
- Tailgate Step w/Tailgate Work Surface
- LED Box Lighting
- 4 Pickup Box Tie-Down Plates
- 6" Angular Bright Anodized Step Bar
- Black Painted Grille w/Chrome Center Bar
- Chrome Door & Tailgate Handles
- Chrome Single-Tip Exhaust
- Heated Door Mirrors
- SYNC 4 w/Enhanced Voice Recognition
- Rear Parking Sensors
- 18" Chrome-Like PVD Wheels

This F-150 XLT is powered by a 2.7L V6 EcoBoost engine paired with a 10-speed automatic transmission and four-wheel drive, delivering the balance of power and efficiency you need. With an EPA rating of 18 city and 24 highway MPG, this truck handles both urban commutes and highway driving responsibly. The white exterior provides a clean, professional appearance that complements any setting.

The Equipment Group 301A Standard package elevates your ownership experience with chrome door and tailgate handles, a wrapped steering wheel for comfortable grip, and a black painted grille with chrome center bar that creates a distinctive front appearance. The dual-zone electronic automatic temperature control ensures both driver and passenger comfort in any season, while the chrome single-tip exhaust adds a refined touch to the rear styling.

The Bed Utility Package transforms your cargo area into a functional workspace. The tailgate step with tailgate work surface provides convenient access and a stable platform for tasks, while LED box lighting illuminates your bed for nighttime loading and unloading. Four pickup box tie-down plates secure your cargo safely and securely. The 6" angular bright anodized step bar makes entering and exiting the truck easier and enhances the truck's profile.

Inside, you'll find a cloth 40/20/40 front seat with console for comfortable seating on long drives. SYNC 4 with enhanced voice recognition provides seamless smartphone integration and hands-free control. Rear parking sensors add an extra layer of convenience when maneuvering in tight spaces. The telescoping and tilt steering wheel adjusts to your ideal driving position, while the trip computer and compass keep you informed on every journey.

The F-150 XLT comes equipped with comprehensive safety features including electronic stability control, traction control, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, and dual front impact airbags. The front wheel independent suspension ensures a smooth ride, while the low tire pressure warning system keeps you informed of your tire condition.

This 2025 Ford F-150 XLT represents a solid investment in a truck that combines capability, comfort, and reliability. We invite you to visit our showroom and experience this vehicle firsthand—our knowledgeable team is ready to answer your questions and help you take the next step.

Heated front seats and a heated steering wheel provide year-round comfort, while the automatic climate control with dual-zone front capability keeps you comfortable regardless of season. The wireless charging pad and dual 120V power outlets keep your devices ready, and the versatile Utili-Track system with tie-down cleats maximizes your cargo options.Technology works for you with wireless smartphone integration, the Intelligent Around View Monitor providing 360-degree visibility, and Moving Object Detection that alerts you to obstacles. The bed under-rail lighting illuminates your work area after dark, and the electronic tailgate lock protects your cargo. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls and SiriusXM satellite radio keep entertainment at your fingertips during every drive.Safety is integrated throughout this build. Blind Spot Warning, Electronic Stability Control, and traction control work together to keep you secure. Multiple airbag systems, including front and rear side, knee, and overhead airbags protect all occupants. Anti-whiplash front head restraints and emergency communication systems provide additional security.The PRO-4X comes equipped with premium cloth seat trim, leather steering wheel, and leather shift knob that elevate the interior experience. Front bucket seats with center armrest provide comfortable seating, while split folding rear seats offer passenger flexibility. Carpeted floor mats, illuminated entry, overhead console, and trip computer complete the thoughtful interior design.With 24,500 miles on the odometer, this 2025 Frontier PRO-4X is ready to serve you with years of reliable service ahead. It includes a complimentary 12-month/15,000-mile warranty for added peace of mind. We invite you to experience this truck firsthand at our dealership and discover why the Frontier PRO-4X is the choice for drivers who refuse to compromise on capability or comfort.

This turbocharged 2.7L engine delivers responsive performance, while the 4WD system and available off-road suspension ensure you're prepared for whatever terrain lies ahead.

- Volcanic Red Tintcoat exterior with distinctive AT4 design
- 2.7L I4 Turbocharged engine with 310 horsepower

This combination ensures the Canyon AT4 performs when it matters most.

The 11.3" infotainment system integrates wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, keeping you connected seamlessly. Wireless phone charging, multiple USB ports, and 120-volt outlets throughout the cabin support modern device management.

The Canyon AT4 includes comprehensive safety technology designed to prevent incidents before they occur. Forward collision alert, lane keep assist with departure warning, rear cross traffic braking, and blind zone steering assist provide active protection during daily driving and highway travel. Automatic emergency braking with pedestrian and cyclist detection adds another layer of confidence in urban environments.

This truck combines practical features that simplify ownership. The remote vehicle starter system lets you warm the cabin or cool it down before entering. The auto-dimming rear-view mirror reduces glare during evening drives. The EZ-Lift and lower tailgate reduces strain during frequent bed access. Heated door mirrors and front fog lights enhance visibility and safety in challenging conditions.
